from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ProvidedPaperRelationship(BaseModel):
    """Relationships of one paper with other papers in the provided collection."""
    paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references_from_collection: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper references")
    cited_by_collection: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that reference this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    paper_relationships: list[ProvidedPaperRelationship]
